Name: Cinematic Wake Up - Customizable Morning Fade Effects
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
[center]
[size=6][b]Cinematic Wake
[/b][/size]
[i][size=3]A smooth, atmospheric "eye-opening" transition for your morning routine.

[/size][/i][/center][center][size=2]Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.
[/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements][size=3]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements[/size][/url][/center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements]
[/url]
[b][size=4]Elevate Your Morning
[/size][/b]
Tired of the harsh, instant jump from a black screen to the bright farm every morning? [b]Cinematic Wake[/b] adds a high-quality, customizable fade-in effect that mimics the way your eyes adjust to light when waking up.

Using quadratic easing math, the transition feels "heavy" and organic—lingering in the darkness for a split second before smoothly sweeping into the morning light.


[color=#ffff00][size=3]Added New Preset - Sleepy Eye: [/size][/color][list]
[*][color=#ffff00][size=3]Sleepy Eyes (New!): Mimics the physical act of opening your eyes. Starts in warm charcoal darkness and smoothly clears to the normal game view.[/size][/color]
[/list]

[youtube]57WrfGD_auQ[/youtube]


[center][/center][center]  [youtube]DhhWM6fr4PE[/youtube]
[/center]


[b]Key Features
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Smooth Wake-Up Fade: [/b]Transitions from a dark screen to a beautiful atmospheric haze before revealing the world.
[*][b]Eye-Opening Math: [/b]Specifically coded with "Quadratic Easing" to mimic eyes slowly adjusting to the light.
[*][b]Atmospheric Presets:[/b] Choose from curated color profiles like Realistic Slate, Golden Morning, or Blue Hour.
[*][b]Fully Configurable:[/b] Adjust your fade duration and colors in real-time using the Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM).
[*][b]Ultra Lightweight: [/b]Zero impact on performance or loading times.
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41252/41252-1768369452-621137055.png[/img]
[b][size=4]
Atmosphere Presets
[/size][/b]
Choose the vibe that fits your farm:
[list]
[list]
[*][b]Realistic Slate:[/b] A neutral, cool gray-blue haze. The most immersive dawn experience.
[*][b]Golden Morning:[/b] A warm, honey-toned light for those bright summer starts.
[*][b]Blue Hour: [/b]A deep, atmospheric dawn blue for a moody, cinematic feel.
[*][b]Custom: [/b]Unlock full RGB sliders to create your own unique morning tint.
[/list][/list]
[b][size=4]Customization Options
[/size][/b]
[list]
[b]Duration:[/b] Set your wake-up time anywhere from a quick 0.5s to a very slow, dramatic 10s (Default is 4.0s).[b]Color Tint:[/b] Full control over Red, Green, and Blue values when using the Custom preset.[/list]
[b][size=4]Requirements
[/size][/b]
[list]
SMAPI (Latest version)Stardew Valley 1.6+[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (Highly recommended for changing settings in-game).[/list]
[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]
[list]
Install the latest version of SMAPI.Download this mod and unzip it into your [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i] folder.Run the game using SMAPI.(Optional) Open the Cog icon on the title screen to customize your fade duration and colors![/list]
